name: zhihu/web/hot-recommend
description: Returns hot recommendation items and content snippets from Zhihu Web. Supports pagination through offset and page_number alongside an optional session_token.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# Zhihu Hot Recommendations API Returns a page of recommended feed items from the Zhihu web home feed. Each item holds an answer with its author, text excerpt and comment count. All inputs are optional: `offset`, `page_number` and `session_token`. ## Use cases - Collect the answers Zhihu currently recommends to build a content curation feed. - Store answer excerpts and author details to study which topics and writers appear in the feed. - Collect answer IDs from the feed and fetch full answers with a second call. - Compare feed pages across `page_number` values to see how the recommendation list changes. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/hot-recommend" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `offset` | string | No | Offset | | `page_number` | string | No | Page Number | | `session_token` | string | No | Session Token | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "data": [ { "action_card": false, "attached_info": "CpIGCMS6qfuZhIW7vAEQBBoJODAyNzYwNDY5IOjBgdcGKAEwAUABSkIKLVRTX1NPVVJDRV9UV09UT1dF…", "brief": "{\"source\": \"TS\", \"type\": \"answer\", \"id\": 2098451264585704463}", "created_time": 1793692132, "id": "1_1793692132.933", "offset": 1, "target": { "allow_segment_interaction": true, "answer_type": "normal", "author": { "avatar_url": "https://pic1.zhimg.com/50/v2-abed1a8c04700ba7d72b45195223e0ff_l.jpg?source=b6762…", "followers_count": 1, "gender": -1, "headline": "", "id": "438712683e436fb415549acab460ed58", "is_followed": false, "is_following": false, "is_org": false }, "comment_count": 1, "content": "

会降价并且已经降价完了，现在先不要买，等第二波看看吧

抖音10…", "created_time": 1793089768, "excerpt": "会降价并且已经降价完了，现在先不要买，等第二波看看吧 抖音10月15日-10月18日是第一波，店铺本身降价且有平台消费券领，我看到好多装机博主，都降价了，97x…", "excerpt_new": "会降价并且已经降价完了，现在先不要买，等第二波看看吧 抖音10月15日-10月18日是第一波，店铺本身降价且有平台消费券领，我看到好多装机博主，都降价了，97x…" }, "type": "feed", "updated_time": 1793692132, "verb": "TOPIC_ACKNOWLEDGED_ANSWER" } ], "fresh_text": "推荐已更新", "paging": { "is_end": false, "is_start": false, "next": "https://www.zhihu.com/api/v3/feed/topstory/recommend?action=down&ad_interval=-10…", "previous": "https://www.zhihu.com/api/v3/feed/topstory/recommend?action=pull&ad_interval=-10…", "totals": 0 } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[]` | One recommended feed item. The list holds several items per page. | | `data[].target.content` | Answer body as HTML. Long answers may be cut, so use the excerpt for plain text. | | `data[].target.excerpt / data[].target.excerpt_new` | Plain text excerpt of the answer, with paragraphs joined by spaces. | | `data[].target.author.id / data[].target.author.headline` | Author ID and the profile headline the author set. The headline can be empty. | | `data[].target.author.followers_count` | Number of followers of the answer author. | | `data[].target.comment_count` | Number of comments on the answer. | | `data[].target.created_time / data[].created_time / data[].updated_time` | Unix timestamps in seconds. `target.created_time` is for the answer, the other two are for the feed item. | | `data[].brief` | JSON string that holds the content `type` (such as `answer`), the `source` and the numeric `id` of the answer. | | `data[].offset` | Position of the item in the feed, starting at 1. | | `paging.next / paging.is_end` | `next` is a ready-made URL for the next feed page. `is_end` shows whether the feed has ended. | ## Notes - Send `{}` to get the first page. Raise `page_number` and `offset` to move forward. - The `next` URL in `paging` contains a `session_token` value. Pass the same value as `session_token` to continue the same feed session. - Read the answer ID from `data[].brief` and pass it to [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail) for the full answer. - For a ranked list of topics instead of a personal-style feed, use [Zhihu Hot List](/apis/zhihu/web/hot-list). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
